claims.text: Self-identified African American pts w NYHA III–IV HFrEF on optimal medical tx: hydralazine + isosorbide dinitrate = recommended.
claims.quote: For patients self-identified as African American with NYHA class III-IV HFrEF who are receiving optimal medical therapy, the combination of hydralazine and isosorbide dinitrate is recommended

claims.text: Can’t take ARNi, ACEi or ARB (intol or renal insuff): H-ISDN might be considered.
